content:
Hey Ram,  

I hear you today wasn’t the best with food—totally okay, life happens and parties can throw us off track. But I’m proud of you for being honest and aware. That’s already half the battle.  

Now, tomorrow? That’s your fresh start—your chance to reset and fuel yourself like the champion you are. Good food = good energy, focus, and strength. You’ve got workouts to crush, goals to hit, and a mindset that’s stronger than any moment of slip.  

One meal at a time, Ram. Stay locked in. I believe in you—now show yourself you do too. 💪🔥  

Let’s make tomorrow count. You’ve got this.  

Coach 💯
